audience: sales and operations teams who manage contacts, companies and deals in Twenty CRM

useCases.title: Review open opportunities and their amounts
useCases.text: The AI lists opportunities with a filter and order you ask for, and reads one in full. It can sum them up by amount.

useCases.title: Show what the CRM holds on a company
useCases.text: The AI finds a company and reads it together with its people, opportunities and notes. You get one overview before a meeting.

useCases.title: Check open tasks and their due dates
useCases.text: The AI lists tasks and reads one task in full. You see what is still open and what is due first.

useCases.title: Add or update a person or company
useCases.text: The AI creates a person or a company from the details you give, or changes fields of an existing one. Only the fields you give are changed.

useCases.title: Create or update an opportunity
useCases.text: The AI creates a deal with a name and an amount in a currency, or changes fields of an existing opportunity.

useCases.title: Write a note or create and update a task
useCases.text: The AI creates a note with a title and body, or a task with a title, or changes an existing task.
